title: Arriving over the mothership
description: An Ice Caves level loads with the message "THERE'S A PSYCHIC PRESENCE HERE!" Under the player's ledge lies the alien craft, and in its last room the Alien Boss, behind a pink barrier. It sends a psychic wave up through the hull, which knocks the player down and takes a heart.
